items.title: Progress is now Insights
items.body: Same board with Body + Mind today, Mind, records and widgets, under a name that fits it all.

items.title: Save a workout from a video
items.body: Saw a cool workout on TikTok or Instagram? Share → MonkeyFit, paste the link, add screenshots or tell Coach, and it becomes your own workout.

items.title: 5 minutes of breathing
items.body: Box breathing, physio sigh and wake-up now start at 5 minutes, the dose tested in research.

items.title: Machines, whole picture
items.body: Machine pages show the full picture, and the body map lights each muscle by its share of the work.

items.title: Explore by type, in colour
items.body: Type pages now group exercises by muscle in gradient sections.

items.title: More in My plan
items.body: Get ready for… and Skill tree now in My plan too.

items.title: Rest day, still a workout
items.body: A workout logged on a rest day now shows as a workout day in the week strip and the Calendar.

items.title: Discarded means gone
items.body: A discarded custom gym session is gone once Undo runs out: no more Resume.

items.title: Share nudges step aside
items.body: Share nudges now slide away on their own, or swipe them down.

items.title: Friendly shares, right away
items.body: Anything unfriendly is turned back on the spot, so you can fix it and share again. No more waiting in review.
